preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.test_section WHERE name = 'Tuberculosis Laboratory'

changeSet.comment: Link standard TB specimen types to Tuberculosis Laboratory (idempotent)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.department_sample_type (id, test_section_id, sample_type_id, is_active, sort_order, lastupdated) SELECT nextval('clinlims.department_sample_type_seq'), ts.id, tos.id, 'Y', v.sort_order, now() FROM clinlims.test_section ts JOIN (VALUES ('sputum', 1), ('bronchoalveolar lavage', 2), ('pleural fluid', 3), ('cerebrospinal fluid', 4), ('tissue', 5), ('body fluid', 6), ('urine', 7), ('stool', 8), ('lymph node', 9) ) AS v(description, sort_order) ON true JOIN clinlims.type_of_sample tos ON LOWER(tos.description) = v.description WHERE ts.name = 'Tuberculosis Laboratory' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.department_sample_type dst WHERE dst.test_section_id = ts.id AND dst.sample_type_id = tos.id );
